items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: And I even had Marge come over one night to play the piano for me.

ctx.x: Well then was the Three Deuces next then? What about this New Deal Club he mentions?
Oh the New Deal, that was just a little joint over on the West Side. They had a lot of gangsters sons who would come in. And I even had Marge come over one night to play the piano for me.
